svg.title: Adam buys steps with two numbers per parameter
svg.desc: A narrow elliptical valley crossed by three descent paths - plain SGD zig-zagging violently, momentum damping it to about fourteen steps, and Adam running almost straight down the floor in four - beside a vertical stacked memory bar for a seven-billion-parameter fine-tune with bf16 weights and gradients at 13.5 GB each, an fp32 master copy and two Adam moment buffers at 27 GB each and 30.6 GB of activations, totalling 141 GB, cut by red dashed lines at the 24 GB and 80 GB card limits.
svg.text: Adam buys steps with two numbers per parameter
plain SGD - 40 steps, still not there
momentum averages the zig-zag away. Adam ALSO
rescales each axis separately - and THAT
rescaling is what costs the memory.
a 24 GB card is 5.9x too small
